text:
Noelle T.: Hi all, luggage got lost on my flight to SE3o Paulo (checked bag didnt arrive). I had to buy toiletries and a work shirt for the client demo (BRL 320 total). Airline gave me a property irregularity report (PIR) but estimated delivery is 3 days. Questions: 1) Are emergency clothing/toiletries reimbursable? 2) Do I file with airline first or submit expense to Redwood now? 3) How does travel insurance factor in?
travel-bot: Automated: attach PIR form, boarding pass, and receipts. For delayed/lost baggage follow airline PIR claim steps; also submit company expense for immediate essentials.
Noelle T.: Attached PIR and receipts. I used cash at a shop near the hotel.
People Ops (Emma): Short answers: 1) Essentials (toiletries, basic clothing required for business) are reimbursable up to a reasonable amount; non-essential personal items (e.g., shoes for walking) are not. 2) File the airline claim; however submit your Redwood expense now (expense_type: baggage_delay_essentials) and mark it "advance_claim" so Finance can expedite. If airline reimburses later, we will reconcile. 3) If you have company travel insurance, it can cover larger losses; we'll provide the insurer contact details after you submit the initial expense.
Finance Team: Upload the following when submitting in the portal: receipts (itemized), PIR.pdf, boarding_pass.png, and a short note describing attempts to recover bag. Use fields (copy/paste):
````
expense_type: baggage_delay_essentials
amount: 320.00
currency: BRL
merchant: Local Shop / Hotel Gift Shop
date: 2026-07-14
payment_method: personal_cash
attachments: receipts.pdf, PIR.pdf, boarding_pass.png
note: emergency essentials purchased after lost bag on flight PNR SCL555; airline PIR attached; manager_approved: yes (Rafael).
````
Finance Team: If airline later reimburses, upload refund evidence and we will close or deduct accordingly. Expect reimbursement processing in 5-10 business days after docs are complete.
Manager (Rafael): I approved the purchase given demo requirements. Sending a quick confirm email now.
Noelle T.: Thanks 44d Also question: if the bag never shows and I need to replace a laptop charger, is that covered?
People Ops (Emma): Laptop chargers and essential work equipment can be reimbursed if you can prove the lost item was business-critical and it's not covered under warranty; Finance will need an itemized receipt and an Airline final loss confirmation (or insurer claim). Pre-approval preferred for > $150.
Insurance-Bot: System: travel_insurance@redwood-inference.com submitted a new claim placeholder for traveler Noelle T.; case ID TI-20260714-78. Please include in expense notes.
Noelle T.: Uploading the airline claim ref and Rafael's email now. Thanks everyone.
